invariants: source size boundary is checked before multi-gigabyte SHA/duration/cost work in the budgeted production entrypoint
provider upload uses file chunks rather than whole-file Data/bytes materialization
output download streams directly to staging and enforces a per-stem byte cap
disk capacity is checked before provider work and rechecked immediately before output download
Swift assurance reclaims stale staging then preflights all staging plus one temporary download and reserve
Swift A14 commit preflights one additional complete incoming copy plus reserve before touching an existing final
storage exhaustion or stream oversize removes partial staging and cannot mark outputs committed
download backpressure is bounded to one active transfer per orchestrator instance under the current evidence policy
transfer telemetry contains byte/time/count/capacity scalars but no source filename, signed output URL, API secret or audio content

scenarios.detail: 128 MiB + 123 byte sparse fixture, 1 MiB chunks, Python tracemalloc peak < 8 MiB

known_external_gaps: Python heap stress is not iPhone RSS/thermal/battery evidence
storage estimate ratios are configurable conservative heuristics and require real codec/provider calibration
filesystem free space can change after preflight; runtime ENOSPC/EDQUOT remains the authoritative safety net
download semaphore is process/orchestrator-local; horizontal multi-instance deployment requires a shared concurrency/resource coordinator
current 2 GiB source cap follows the checked-in AudioShake adapter/deployment boundary and is not a Moises parity claim
real long-track provider, iPhone interruption, thermal and battery evidence is still required for P021
